A '''Force-Feed Air Intake''' was a component of [[Flamethrower/Legends|flame projectors]] such as [[Flame Carbine]]s and [[Flame Rifle]]s. On a [[carbine]], the Force-Feed Air Intake was connected to the weapon's [[Pressurized Fuel Chamber]]. On the [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], the Force-Feed Air Intake sat above the weapon's grip and setting controls.<ref name="EGWT" />
